bench_or.description: Biomedical (scaled bench-top OR / laboratory rig, illustrative geometry): the course arm carries a 0.125 kg instrument carrier from the ready pose A above the instrument tray to a hand-over point on its left, B2.  A sterile-drape dome (sphere 1) and a lamp head (sphere 2) clutter the way; the bench top is the plane z = 0 and a screen on the right is the plane x <= 0.30 m.

eod_rig.description: Defence, protective use (scaled EOD training rig, illustrative geometry): the same arm reaches from the ready pose A over the rim of an open crate to grasp an inert mock package at D2 on its right. The crate rim is modelled by three spheres; the table is the plane z = 0.
